title: Add Claude Code plugin marketplace
description:
Make this repository a valid Claude Code plugin marketplace and package the public drive-task Meads skill as its first plugin.

Implemented `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, a self-contained `plugins/drive-task` plugin, and README installation instructions.

Validation:
- Marketplace and plugin pass `claude plugin validate --strict` with zero warnings.
- Isolated marketplace add and plugin install succeed; Claude reports one enabled `drive-task` skill at version 1.0.0.
- Bundled SKILL.md matches the committed private source byte-for-byte.
- `go install .` succeeds from `cmd/md`.
